name: DANDI NWB Inspector
summary: Checks a public NWB file on the DANDI Archive against NWB best practices with NWB Inspector, streaming it without a full download, and outputs text and JSON reports.
description: Parses the dandiset ID, version and asset ID from a DANDI asset API URL, resolves its S3 location with the DANDI API, streams the file with remfile and runs nwbinspector on it. Use it to validate NWB files before or after publishing on DANDI. It takes no input dataset, only the asset_url parameter, and needs internet access.

outputs.description: NWB Inspector results as report.txt (human-readable, grouped by importance) and report.json.

parameters.description: Full DANDI asset API URL, e.g. https://api.dandiarchive.org/api/dandisets/<id>/versions/<version>/assets/<asset_id>/.

failure_modes.message: Could not parse DANDI asset URL
failure_modes.cause: asset_url does not have the dandisets/<id>/versions/<version>/assets/<asset_id> form.
failure_modes.fix: Use the full DANDI asset API URL.
